notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

This is very small update with just a few but useful things

[list]
[*] The ability to send a report directly from the game has been added. There is no dedicated button for it, but if you have any bug, problem, or just a suggestion, you can open the report popup at any time by pressing Ctrl + R
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39425363/eeef02250caa39b79dfd11c79a460cbfa0330e3b.png[/img]
[*] The ability to rotate the puzzle counterclockwise with the right mouse button has been added. This can make the puzzle a bit faster and easier. You can still rotate the puzzle clockwise as usual with the left mouse button
[*] Fixed a resolution issue when switching between fullscreen and windowed modes
[/list]

There will be new scenes for Alice and Jessica in the next update as they have the fewest. Additionally
soon there will be a new type of puzzles based on the Voronoi diagram where you will not be limited to a specific selection of puzzles but rather you will be able to choose as many puzzles as you want from the range and each time you start the game they will have a different shape as they will be randomly generated!

Thank you!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New update, more content!
notes.notes:
The new update is here and there are more scenes as always! This time, Jessica and Stella have an additional location and puzzle to explore, as shown in the example below ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39425363/a9efc60720b54332e985bb000eec3573f37ac97c.png[/img]

We also updated the options window with some requested features like full screen mode, the ability to change the resolution or target frame rate. This window is now also available when solving a puzzle. With spicy images ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39425363/9edb798a314d3d034e81708a5c661168dbc2b38e.png[/img]

Fixed some bugs in gameplay and localization and also added a Spanish translation thanks to one of the players!
